remarks: Welcome to 8947 County Route 3 in Centerville, NY — a 0.48-acre lot with the infrastructure already in place to build your perfect getaway, whether that's a camp, a mobile home, or a small home. A functional drilled water well, septic system with two hookups, and electric service are all set up and ready to go, and the included 1993 Park Villa camper means you can be enjoying the view out back from day one. Outdoor lovers will love the location: Swift Hill State Forest (1,500+ acres) and Lost Nation State Forest (1,300+ acres) are just down the road, and Letchworth State Park is only a 20-minute drive away. Come see it for yourself and make this lot your own personal escape.
facts: Rectangular, Rectangular Lot, Residential Lot, Rural Lot, Gentle Sloping
